$comment: Ban lists the checkers enforce. supplyChain is the floor every app keeps: compromised or protestware packages (scope anywhere: fail wherever they sit in package-lock.json) and npm-deprecated packages that stale examples still install (scope direct: fail as a direct dependency). profiles are opt-in, and offline-only bans everything no-telemetry bans (an app without network sends no telemetry): an app that lists a profile in contracts/dependency-policy.json "profiles" copies its entries into "banned" (the app's own gate reads only that file). Deprecation and compromise facts verified with npm view on 2026-10-03.

supplyChain.reason: the malicious payload of the 2018 event-stream compromise; npm replaced it with a security placeholder, so a copy means a stale or poisoned lockfile
supplyChain.useInstead: regenerate the lockfile from a clean tree

supplyChain.reason: protestware: node-ipc 10.1.1 to 10.1.3 overwrote files on some machines and later releases pull peacenotwar, which writes files to the desktop
supplyChain.useInstead: remove the dependency that pulls it in (npm explain <pkg>)

supplyChain.reason: deprecated: the global Expo CLI was superseded by the local CLI (npx expo) and eas-cli
supplyChain.useInstead: npx expo (comes with expo), and EAS CLI installed globally (npm install -g --min-release-age=7 --ignore-scripts eas-cli@<x.y.z>), never through npx inside the repo

supplyChain.reason: deprecated: react-native-unimodules was replaced by the expo package, expo-random by expo-crypto
deprecated: the package moved to @react-native-async-storage/async-storage and this name gets no fixes
supplyChain.useInstead: expo-sqlite/kv-store (or the maintained name, if the app's policy allows it)

supplyChain.reason: deprecated: replaced by @react-native/babel-preset, which babel-preset-expo already includes
deprecated and unmaintained (request since 2020, node-sass unsupported, expo-firebase-analytics retired)
supplyChain.useInstead: the built-in fetch; sass; an analytics SDK behind a port (analytics-and-consent)

offline-only.reason: offline-only: OTA updates are network traffic
offline-only.useInstead: reloadAppAsync from expo to restart; ship changes through the stores

offline-only.reason: offline-only: development builds open a network inspector and load bundles from Metro; test release builds instead
offline-only.useInstead: release builds on a named simulator or emulator

offline-only.reason: offline-only: its default reachability check fetches a Google URL from the app
offline-only: every purchase goes through RevenueCat's servers

offline-only.useInstead: no replacement; the profile rules this feature out

offline-only.reason: offline-only: crash reporting services send reports over the network

offline-only.useInstead: no replacement; the profile rules this feature out

offline-only.reason: offline-only: push registration contacts Apple, Google and Expo servers
offline-only.useInstead: no replacement (or a local-only notification module the profile reviews)

offline-only.reason: offline-only: product analytics send events over the network
offline-only.useInstead: no replacement; the profile rules this feature out

offline-only.reason: offline-only: web views are a network surface
offline-only: the app makes no requests (some tools pull these in transitively, so only direct dependencies count)
offline-only.useInstead: nothing in the app; Node's built-in fetch in tooling

no-telemetry.useInstead: no replacement; the profile rules this feature out
no replacement; the profile rules this feature out
no replacement; the profile rules this feature out
